note: One source for both key pages. The phone page bundles this at build time; the local page fetches it from the host. Free-tier figures are as published in September 2026; keep them short and re-check them at release.

providers.name: Cartesia
providers.tagline: Natural voices, fast. The default pick.
providers.free: 20,000 credits a month: about 25 minutes of speech plus a couple of hours of listening.
providers.fine_print: Free plan is for personal use; paid plans start at $5 a month.
providers.key_help: Create an account, then generate an API key for your organization.
providers.usage: Every month you get 20,000 free credits, shared by listening and speaking. Your agent talking uses them fastest: about 25 minutes of it talking uses up the month. In practice that's an hour or two of calls a month with short replies. Credits reset monthly and don't carry over.

providers.name: Deepgram
providers.free: $200 of credit that never expires: dozens of hours of conversation.
providers.fine_print: Pay as you go after the credit is used.
providers.key_help: Create an account, then create a project API key.
providers.usage: A one-time $200 credit that never expires. Listening costs about 50 cents per hour of call, and your agent talking about $1.60 per hour of speech. An hour-long call where the agent talks for about 10 minutes costs under a dollar, so the credit covers a couple of hundred hours of calls.

providers.name: ElevenLabs
providers.free: 10,000 credits a month: about 10 minutes of speech.
providers.fine_print: Free plan is non-commercial; paid plans start at $5 a month.
providers.key_help: Create an account, then create an API key with text-to-speech and voice access.
providers.usage: Every month you get 10,000 free credits. Each character your agent says uses one, so that's about 10 minutes of it talking a month: enough to try the voices, not for daily use.

providers.name: OpenRouter
providers.tagline: The key your agent may already have.
providers.free: Listening for cents an hour; Grok voices about a dollar an hour of speech, or the Flux voices (Hannah, Kit) free. Same key as the models.
providers.card: Uses the balance you already have; no separate sign-up.
providers.fine_print: Replies start about half a second later than with a dedicated speech key, because listening is one request per turn.
providers.key_help: Create an API key in your OpenRouter account, or reuse the one your agent uses.
providers.usage: No free allowance: it's paid from your OpenRouter balance. Listening costs about 9 cents per hour of you talking, and the Grok voices about 80 cents per hour of the agent talking. An hour-long call where you talk for 20 minutes and the agent for 10 costs about 15 cents.

providers.name: Venice
providers.tagline: Private inference; the key your agent may already have.
providers.free: Parakeet listening and Grok voices from your prepaid credits, about a dollar an hour of speech.
providers.card: Uses the credits you already have; no separate sign-up.
providers.fine_print: Replies start about half a second later than with a dedicated speech key.
providers.key_help: Create an API key in your Venice account, or reuse the one your agent uses.
providers.usage: Paid from your Venice credits. Listening costs about 36 cents per hour of you talking, and the Grok voices about a dollar per hour of the agent talking. An hour-long call where you talk for 20 minutes and the agent for 10 costs about 30 cents.

providers.name: Groq
providers.free: Whisper listening for a few cents an hour; Orpheus voices.
providers.fine_print: Replies start about half a second later than with a dedicated speech key.
providers.key_help: Create an API key in the Groq console, or reuse the one your agent uses.
providers.usage: Paid from your Groq account. Whisper listening costs a few cents per hour of you talking; the Orpheus voice is billed by the characters the agent says.

providers.name: Together
providers.free: Listening for cents an hour; Cartesia voices at a few dollars an hour of speech.
providers.fine_print: Replies start about half a second later than with a dedicated speech key.
providers.key_help: Create an API key in your Together account, or reuse the one your agent uses.
providers.usage: Paid from your Together account. Listening costs cents per hour; the Cartesia voices a few dollars per hour of the agent talking. An hour-long call with short replies costs well under a dollar.

providers.name: Local
providers.free: Unlimited. Runs on the agent's own computer. Download size depends on the models you choose.
providers.fine_print: Voice quality and reply speed depend on the model and this computer. Choose local models below.
providers.usage: Free and unlimited: listening and speaking run on this computer, so there's nothing to count.
